_nota: Traducción v03 de la web (textos en tú), aplicada el 21 oct 2026 por Diseño. Base: 003_TEXTOS/20261021_XM_WEB_EN_v03.json + inglés del .md v03 y del brief del Modelo comercial vivo. Las cifras del modelo las escribe el código en cada idioma.
Un predio, un edificio, un espacio vale: A site, a building, a space is worth what it can become. We discover it with you from the first line, through design, sustainability and human experience.
Transformamos predios y espacios en luga: We turn sites and spaces into places people want to live in.
X.FORM es un estudio de arquitectura en: X.FORM is an architecture studio in Bogotá. We bring strategy, design, technique and development to the same table, in balance with the setting and the culture of each place.
Cada proyecto lo construimos contigo. De: We build every project with you. From the first question (what fits, what makes sense, what story the place wants to tell) to the day someone moves in.
Trabajamos con rigor técnico y viabilida: We work with technical rigor and financial viability to leave places that are more sustainable and more valuable. The shape a well-made decision takes goes beyond design.
Antes del trazo, la idea. En talleres co: Before the line, the idea. In workshops with you we read the place, the audience and the moment, and that reading becomes the concept that guides everything else: what gets built, for whom and with what character.
Arquitectura, interiorismo, urbanismo y: Architecture, interiors, urban design and landscape come from the same pencil. We work light, material and movement with the technical rigor that codes and construction demand.
Llevamos el proyecto hasta que se vuelve: We carry the project until it becomes matter. We coordinate disciplines, schedules and costs, and on site we make sure what was drawn arrives intact.
Escuchamos el terreno y te escuchamos a: We listen to the site and we listen to you. We set the vision and the criteria that will hold every decision that follows.
La estrategia se vuelve idea arquitectón: Strategy becomes an architectural idea: its own way of taking in light, of arriving and of moving through.
La idea se vuelve técnica. Coordinamos e: The idea becomes technique. We coordinate structure, systems and detail, version after version, until the project is ready to build and keeps its character.
Estamos en la obra hasta la entrega. Cad: We stay on site until handover. Every material that arrives is checked against the idea that gave rise to it.
Cifras de ejemplo, sin relación con un p: Sample figures, unrelated to any real project.
Las imágenes de Cayetana tienen retoque: The Cayetana images have been retouched with artificial intelligence.
Quien firma el proyecto es quien lo diri: The person who signs the project is the one who leads it.
Arquitecto de la Universidad de los Ande: Architect from Universidad de los Andes, with a master's in Landscape and Urbanism from the University of Pennsylvania. He thinks about each project from the landscape inward.
Estrategia, paisaje, urbanismo, biofilia: Strategy, landscape, urban design, biophilia and neuroarchitecture work together from the first sketch, to create atmospheres the body remembers.
Cuéntanos qué tienes en mente: Tell us what you have in mind
Tres preguntas para darte una primera le: Three questions for a first read on the scale of your project and the next step.
01 · ¿Qué quieres hacer?: 01 · What do you want to build?
02 · ¿Qué área imaginas?: 02 · How much area do you have in mind?
Responde las tres preguntas para ver tu: Answer the three questions to see your reading.
Una primera lectura para orientar la con: A first reading to guide the conversation. We work out the details together at our first meeting.
Cuéntanos dónde está tu terreno y qué im: Tell us where your land is and what you imagine for it.
El agua llegó primero. El lago interior: Water came first. The inner lake decided where the landscape would open and where the shade would gather, and from that edge we drew the streets, the paths and the canal that carries the breeze down to the sea.
El lago y el mar · Cayetana, Barú: The lagoon and the sea · Cayetana, Barú
Al final del recorrido, el mar. El club: At the end of the path, the sea. The club opens onto the beach with generous shade, wood underfoot and a pier for staying until the afternoon fades.
La playa al atardecer · Cayetana, Barú: The beach at sunset · Cayetana, Barú
Tres maneras de habitar Cayetana. La Vil: Three ways to live in Cayetana. Villa Eivissa is made of lime, wood and arches that soften the sun. Villa Macarella follows the slope and steps down toward the view. Villa Savina stays on a single floor and climbs to the roof to meet the horizon.
En VITA 119 el bienestar sube con el edi: At VITA 119, wellbeing rises with the building. It greets you in the lobby, opens to the air on the 4th floor and finds the light again on the 12th, among gardens that hang from the façade. VT Residences and the Experience Center are part of the same project.
Arquitectura: Francisco Ospina y Camilo: Architecture: Francisco Ospina and Camilo Restrepo · X.FORM. Development: Elemento Constructora.
Un lugar para bajar el ritmo en medio de: A place to slow down in the middle of the city. Casa Alma arranges its spaces around the body and calm: filtered light, warm materials and paths that ask you to arrive slowly.
Una casa pensada para la brisa del Carib: A house designed for the Caribbean breeze. Deep shade, rooms that open to the outdoors and a life lived between the terrace and the water.
La casa blanca de Lagos del Peñón. Volúm: The white house at Lagos del Peñón. Pale volumes that take in the lowland sun and turn it into cool shade. The whole house opens onto the garden.
Un proyecto en este punto se beneficia d: A project at this point benefits from a strategy phase: three to four weeks to read the place, set the vision and learn what is worth building.
Con el lote en la mano, el primer paso e: With the site in hand, the first step is a massing study: understanding what the code allows and what the land asks for before drawing.
Podemos entrar a revisar, coordinar o pr: We can step in to review, coordinate or deepen what already exists and build on the work done.
Entramos a la ejecución con control técn: We join construction with technical control and direction, so that what gets built keeps the idea.
Los proyectos de más de 10.000 m² o de m: Projects over 10,000 m² or masterplans usually start with a strategy session before the concept.
Arquitecto de la Pontificia Universidad: Architect from Pontificia Universidad Javeriana, with a master's in Interior Design for Retail Spaces from IED Barcelona.
